description: A team driven by sheer curiosity, creativity, and a fascination with space and it's unknowns, or maybe of what remains of the human touch. We’re interested in exploring real-world challenges through research, technology, design, and innovative thinking. Our goal is to bring together different strengths and perspectives to build something thoughtful, engaging, and meaningful.
summary:
Our goal is to tell the story of the echoes of human ingenuity and exploration scattered beyond the limits of home. These machines and hardware, left behind in places beyond the grasp of human hands, have profoundly changed us as a species through their discoveries and perseverance.
​Yet humans are prone to forgetting, often preserving these machines in the popular mind as mere names, losing sight of what they were and what they actually did.
By reconstructing the scientific journeys of multiple NASA machines, tracing the questions they were designed to answer, the instruments they carried, and the discoveries they made possible, we connect each machine to its scientific contribution. Through the power of film, we take a step toward restoring this hardware to the larger story of human discovery.
And thus we are the team, 'Space bar', presenting the topic through a short 7 minutes long film.
details:
Our film is a story of human exploration told through some of the machines NASA has

sent into space, specifically Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Mars Global Surveyor,

Curiosity, Perseverance, and InSight. Beyond Mars, we tell the story of the Ranger

program, Lunar Orbiter, and Project Apollo. In this film, we blend science and

storytelling to show that these machines are more than just names, inspiring people to

explore the project we have all been a part of as a species ever since humanity first

sent a piece of us into space.

The tools we used are being stated below:

- Available editorial tools from Capcut (free version) on tablet and laptop.

- Adobe illustrator and Ibis paint X for graphics design.
- Lexis Audio Editor and Default Apple Photo/Video Editor was used to edit the voice over.
